title: Replicate the Elements of a List a Given Number of Times

entrypoints.name: replicate
entrypoints.effects: none stated; benchmark requires a deterministic pure result

input_domain.count: The authoritative statement demonstrates a positive count (3). It does not state behavior for 0 or negative integers; this benchmark does not add a behavior for those values.

entrypoints.required_behavior_for_positive_count: For every source occurrence, emit exactly count consecutive occurrences of that value, processing source occurrences from left to right. Equal values in distinct source positions remain distinct groups.

unsupported_or_unstated_dimensions.infinite_streams: not applicable; OCaml lists are finite
unsupported_or_unstated_dimensions.strings: the official example uses strings, but the signature is polymorphic
unsupported_or_unstated_dimensions.floats: not singled out; polymorphic value handling is required
